state: source preparation assigned after c03 frozen peer
scope: Source-only preparation for canonical Difference-in-differences and event studies: parallel trends, anticipation, staggered adoption, event studies, weighting and sensitivity. Root owns subsequent blueprint/author assignment; no manuscript or checker now.

primary_leads: Callaway and SantAnna, Difference-in-Differences with Multiple Time Periods: author primary version, group-time estimands, never/not-yet controls, aggregation and identification conditions.

Sun and Abraham, Estimating Dynamic Treatment Effects in Event Studies with Heterogeneous Treatment Effects: primary author version, contamination of relative-time TWFE coefficients and estimand construction.
Goodman-Bacon, Difference-in-differences with variation in treatment timing: primary author version, two-by-two decomposition, already-treated controls and heterogeneous/dynamic effect limitations.
Rambachan and Roth, A More Credible Approach to Parallel Trends: primary author version, explicit departure restrictions, sensitivity versus identification and pretest limitations.
